title: Overnight Humidity Recovery Failure
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mould:risk
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour<6
| stats avg(humidity_pct) as overnight_humidity, min(dewpoint_gap) as worst_gap by room
| eval failed_recovery=if(overnight_humidity>65 OR worst_gap<3,1,0)
| where failed_recovery=1
description: Flags rooms that stay damp or condensation-prone all night instead of recovering by morning.
value: If a room cannot recover overnight, the mould risk is no longer a short blip but a persistent condition.
implementation: Ingest humidity and dew-point-gap readings into `index=personal`; alert on rooms that stay risky overnight.
visualization: Room table of overnight humidity and worst dew-point gap.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which rooms stay too damp all night instead of drying out by morning, giving mould a better chance to settle in.
